test_consistency: test the CLIP model consistency between JIT and Python implementations across all available models
run_test_consistency: run the test_consistency function to verify JIT and Python CLIP model outputs match within tolerance
review_test_consistency: review the test_consistency function that compares JIT-compiled and pure Python CLIP model probabilities
summarize_test_consistency: summarize the test_consistency function which validates CLIP model outputs are consistent across compilation modes
refactor_test_consistency: refactor the test_consistency function to support additional tolerance thresholds or device configurations
